newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SingTel no comment on Indonesia rumour.
newsitem.headline: SingTel no comment on Indonesia rumour.

text.p: Singapore Telecommunications Ltd (SingTel) declined comment on Thursday on rumours circulating the Jakarta stock market that it was taking a stake in PT Telekomunikasi Indonesia (Telekom).
"We do not comment on rumour and speculation," a SingTel spokeswoman told Reuters.
The spokeswoman would neither confirm nor deny the market talk which helped send Telekom shares up 150 rupiah to 4,050 rupiah on the Jakarta stock exchange by 0755 GMT.
"From the company's side we have no plan to sell a stake to Singapore Telecom," Thomas Widjanarto, head of Telekom's investor relations unit, told Reuters.
SingTel shares in Singapore were largely unmoved by the speculation, up a cent at Singapore $2.52 at 0755 GMT.

Former state communications monopoly SingTel has said the domestic market -- set to open to full competition by 2000 after introducing competition to paging and cellular services on April 1 -- is its top priority, but it would consider other Asia-Pacific investments when appropriate.
